Settings open again after an update from v0.0.1 or v0.0.2, and the saved home networks stay.

## Changes
- Fix: v0.0.3 crashed when Settings opened if home networks had been saved by v0.0.1 or v0.0.2,
  also when Android restored those settings from a backup. v0.0.3 read the Wi-Fi name of such a
  network as empty, so it also did not switch to the home address on that network. This release
  reads the networks saved by every earlier release, and the home address works with them again.

## Install
Installing this release over v0.0.1, v0.0.2 or v0.0.3 keeps the session, the saved credentials and
the home networks. Do not uninstall the app, that erases the session and the saved credentials.

If Settings crash on v0.0.3, the "Update" button in Settings → App cannot be reached: download the
APK below and open it, or use `adb install -r`. Android installs it over the current app. Later
updates work from Settings → App → "Update".

Requires Android 12 (API 31) or newer, arm64-v8a or armeabi-v7a.
